purpose: Research queue only. Entries are not adapters and do not enable hardware operations.
policy: No manufacturer or model is declared compatible without exact VID/PID/revision/firmware identity, protocol evidence and repeatable physical tests.

targets.notes: HE switch technology does not imply a shared host protocol. Do not probe vendor reports or write settings based on category alone.
Sensor family and retail brand do not establish a common configuration protocol. Exact device identity and documented transport are required.
Different retail names may share an ODM design, while identical names may ship different revisions. Never infer protocol compatibility from appearance or seller name.
